en:
What's left to argue? Let's hurry up
and start the vote already.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monkuma doesn't know who the culprit is...
He's relying on my deductions.
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>So...I have to do this...
I believe in Kaito!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito is trying to ruin the game.
That's why he's hiding the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know exactly why, but
he's putting his life on the line for it.

<CLT=cltMIND>So to put my faith in him...
this is the only way.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everything that we've determined up to
now... What if I turned it all on its head?
